name: Krysta death
doc: Krysta death (enemy attack 277): the GF cinematic engine's clone run from the two script files (mag263_b.00 / .01, its parameters) - the caster's model falling apart polygon by polygon - its pieces, dots and particles. The program calls the clone's own setup (the engine's state block is shared, one clone at a time), its root re-pointed at the program's director; the tick is the port's (FFNx mag264_krysta_264.cpp), the file loader ProgramFiles' (gfc_engine.h).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.
